title: Input head at the left boundary
statement: For every natural number $n$, moving the input head left from position $0$ by one step, with positions restricted to $0,\ldots,n+1$, leaves it at position $0$.
replaced:
On an input of length $n$, attempting to move the input head left (by the sign $-1$)
from the leftmost position $0$ results in no movement: the clamped move of $0$ by $-1$
is again $0$.
